voices.note: Sukkah 1:7 (15a.13): skewers / bed boards; the grain stack
anonymous redactorial voice of this sugya

props.gloss_en: one who roofs his sukkah with skewers or with the long boards of the bed: if there is space between them equal to them, it is valid
one who hollows out a grain stack to make himself a sukkah -- it is not a sukkah
Rav Pappa: where the breached equals the standing, it is permitted
Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua: [where the breached equals the standing] it is forbidden
(on Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua's behalf) what is 'equal to them'? [a space such that the roofing] enters and leaves
R' Ami: [the mishnah speaks of a case] where he makes [the space] exceed
Rava: you may even say [the mishnah speaks of a case] where he does not make it exceed
Rava: if they [the skewers] lay lengthwise, he places [the valid roofing] widthwise; if widthwise, he places it lengthwise

challenges.gloss_en: לימא תיהוי תיובתא דרב הונא בריה דרב יהושע -- the mishnah validates a sukkah whose open spaces equal its unfit skewers, against his 'equal is forbidden'

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב הונא בריה דרב יהושע: מאי כמותן — בנכנס ויוצא (= p_kemotan_nichnas_veyotze)

objections.gloss_en: והא אפשר לצמצם! -- but it is possible to be exact [so the mishnah's case can be one of exact equality]

answered_by.gloss_en: רבא אמר: אפילו תימא בשאין מעדיף, אם היו נתונים שתי — נותנן ערב, ערב — נותנן שתי (= p_rava_ein_maadif, p_rava_shti_erev)
